snippet.title: Voice of Nature -  Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Voice of Nature is a farming simulation game based on isekai and fantasy theme. Combine with pixel art and anime.

In the beginning of the game, you will start from zero and no abandoned farm you can get for free.
But, by joining Adventure Guild you can start your isekai journey! Increase adventure rank, join dungeon raids, defeat monsters and stop the evil king to destroy the world!

Now you have enough to buy land for your new life. Build your farm, raise animals, plants some crops, learn some magic, find love and many more.

✨️ Wishlist Now ✨
